name: Hyprdrive
author: dragos
description: Mission-control overview, a full dock (stacks, previews, drive and network mounts) and Mosaic, a hybrid layout, for Hyprland on Omarchy, plus this settings panel: one animation curve and speed for everything, per-animation motion blur, a trackpad gesture editor, and performance and AC/battery profiles. The panel installs with the plugin; the compositor plugin itself is built from source against your Hyprland (see the README).

barWidget.description: Overview, dock, animation, motion blur, gestures and performance.
